narrative:
Good morning, Morten. Here is LINK's FY2026 gross profit picture as of last night's traffic.

**Gross profit** in the Q3 Forecast is **NOK 1,690M**, +8.2% on FY2025 (NOK 1,562M) — **NOK 30M (1.7%) short** of the NOK 1,720M MyLINK CORE double-digit ambition in the budget. September GP was NOK 144M, +NOK 12M on August.

**Adjusted EBITDA** is NOK 680M, 40.2% of GP — above the 38% floor, so the finance gate passes.

**Key movements:**
• Conversational Channels +30.8% (WhatsApp +NOK 40M)
• Global Wholesale −8.8% at a 6% margin
• Nordic operators raise A2P termination 5–7% from 1 January

**Pending your decision:** Q3 Forecast sign-off, Nordic termination pass-through and the conversational stretch lever.

signals.title: FY2026 GP forecast NOK 30M short of the double-digit ambition
signals.source: SDP Q3 Forecast (9+3) vs FY2026 Budget (MyLINK CORE ambition)
signals.excerpt: Gross profit lands at NOK 1,690M (+8.2% on FY2025), NOK 30M (1.7%) below the NOK 1,720M ambition. Growth is broad across the five European markets; the gap is a mix issue, not a market issue.

signals.title: Conversational GP +30.8% — WhatsApp adds NOK 40M
signals.source: SDP GP by product family — FY2026 forecast vs FY2025 actual
signals.excerpt: Conversational Channels grow GP to NOK 280M (16.6% of group GP). WhatsApp Business adds +NOK 40M on Meta per-message pricing and template migration; RCS grows +56% from a small base.

signals.title: Nordic operators raise A2P termination 5–7% from 1 January
signals.source: Operator notices (Telenor, Telia, Telia Finland) — Carrier & Termination Cost phase
signals.excerpt: Termination cost is NOK 5,773M, 77% of revenue. Routing absorbs part of the increase; the remainder must be passed through in Enterprise SMS pricing to protect GP per message.
